response.sql:
WITH grouped AS (
  SELECT
    oi.order_item_id,
    p.product_color,
    AVG(CAST(ili.product_quantity AS REAL)) AS avg_invoiced_quantity,
    AVG(
      (ili.derived_product_cost - ili.derived_total_cost)
      / NULLIF(ili.derived_total_cost, 0)
    ) AS avg_cost_ratio
  FROM Invoice_Line_Items AS ili
  JOIN Order_Items AS oi
    ON oi.order_item_id = ili.order_item_id
  JOIN Products AS p
    ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
  GROUP BY oi.order_item_id, p.product_color
), ranked AS (
  SELECT
    order_item_id,
    product_color,
    avg_invoiced_quantity,
    avg_cost_ratio,
    RANK() OVER (
      PARTITION BY product_color
      ORDER BY avg_invoiced_quantity DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS rank
  FROM grouped
)
SELECT
  order_item_id,
  product_color,
  avg_invoiced_quantity,
  avg_cost_ratio,
  rank
FROM ranked
WHERE rank <= 3

assumptions.assumption: The product color comes from the product referenced by the matched order item. Quantity values are numeric strings; they are cast to numbers for averaging.

alternatives.interpretation: If color should come from the product referenced by each invoice line item instead, join Products using ili.product_id.
